question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (2)
solution:
The correct answer is '**opportunity**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the circumstances under which lions might prey on the young of larger mammal species.
 
• The term “**opportunity**” refers to a set of circumstances that makes it possible to do something, which fits the context of the lions finding and taking advantage of a chance to hunt these animals.
 
• Other options like "state", "condition", and "capacity" do not fit as well in this context because they do not describe a chance or occasion.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Lions are carnivores, which means they only *consume__* meat. They will eat almost any animal they can catch, however the most of the time it is buffalo, zebra, giraffe, warthog, and antelope species. If the *__opportunity__* arises, they will also prey on the young of larger mammal species *__such__* as rhinos and elephants. The majority of the preys will weigh between 50 and 300kg. Male lions can eat approximately 7 kg of meat per day. *__Whereas__* females eat approximately 4.5 kg. Both are *__capable__* of consuming up to 15% of their body weight in a single meal!*
